reason: The plugin performs one-time reconnaissance of web applications by inspecting accessibility trees and network APIs, then stores playbooks for later endpoint replay through a dedicated browser.

summaries.zh: 通过专用浏览器侦察网页应用的可访问性树和真实接口，并将结果保存为可复用的接口操作手册。
summaries.en: Reconnaissance plugin that inspects a web application's accessibility tree and network APIs, then saves reusable playbooks for later endpoint replay.

capabilities: Uses a dedicated browser through the Chrome DevTools Protocol
Inspects web pages, accessibility trees, and network endpoints
Stores reusable endpoint playbooks as local JSON files
Replays discovered HTTP endpoints using the browser session
Can interact with signed-in sessions and state-changing requests when explicitly enabled
